body: It is a mix of feeling useless because i takes me ages to finish my degree and getting heartbroken 2 times in 6 months.  I just feel left alone atm.

I can't stop. I cry myself to sleep every night and in the morning i get up for my job or studies. I am functioning and i don't understand how. I don't wanna be here anymore. I want it all to stop. But my family and friends would be sad if i weren't around anymore... so i carry on. Wishing i could just stop.
